mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the FEDFUNDS rate increased by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening economy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the UNRATE increased by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP over two consecutive quarters signals a strengthening economy, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where GDPC1 increased over two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals a contraction in supply, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO declined by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate signals a strengthening demand and labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases & UNRATE decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST increased and UNRATE decreased.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls over two consecutive months signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increased over two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate combined with an increase in real GDP signals an accommodative monetary policy supporting economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases & GDPC1 increases in 1 quarter
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS decreased and GDPC1 increased.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail and food services sales over two consecutive months signals a strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where RSAFS increased over two consecutive months.
